description: MAP-6 rule 7: a stored-cache resource on a provider without that tier RAISES before the wire. Dropping it would send the request without the prompt prefix the resource holds (MAP-13: refuse when a guess could hurt).

provenance.evidence: docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-6 rule 7 ("Providers without the tier RAISE"); lm15-python, lm15-ts and lm15-go dropped it silently on this provider until 2026-09-24 while lm15-rs refused (changes/2026-09-24-cache-resource-refusal.md)

canonical_request_provenance.evidence: authored with the case; the model is the provider's corpus model
